{{Top|leg}}
'''Fleethund''' was the terminology used by [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for a dangerous decoy maneuver whereby one pilot attracted enemy fire to themselves in draw it away from other ships, for instance a convoy.
